自己的目的已然达到，二长老拱手一礼，径自离去。
“难道你不怕他将今日的密会上报给银月妖帝？到时候我们可都讨不到好。”
大长老冷笑一声，“他不敢这么做，银月狼族内部的关系向来错综复杂，他二长老也并非全无把柄。”
“今日他既然来参加了我们的密会，那就永远不可能彻底撇清关系，就算他想要永远倒下银月妖帝那一边，他也始终只是一个外人，对方会心存芥蒂，两边不讨好。”
“况且，你以为我们对王族不满的事情，银月妖帝他不知道吗？”
“别忘了，这里是银月狼族，他银月妖帝对于这个地方的掌控早已是登峰造极。”
“之所以不动我们，无非是顾及我们两脉的底蕴，怕给帝族带来毁灭性的打击罢了。”
“话虽如此，但他终究没有与我们站在一边。”三长老的声音从兜帽阴影中幽幽传来，沙哑如枯叶摩擦，“妖帝那边和顾云走的那么近，若是二长老再倒向他们，你我二人的话语权就会被大大衰落，届时莫说是分权制衡，便是自保都难。”
大长老沉默良久，粗壮的指节在桌面上轻轻叩击着，发出沉闷而规律的笃笃声。
片刻后，他抬起眼，目光如刀般落在三长老那张隐在兜帽下的脸上。
“三长老既然看得这般透彻，莫非是有了什么对策？”
三长老沉默片刻，随后从怀中取出一枚闪着赤红之色的鳞片，轻轻搁在桌面之上。
那鳞片约莫半个巴掌大小，通体如烧融的岩浆般泛着灼热的暗红光芒，表面密布着细密的纹路。
鳞片触及桌面的瞬间，议事堂中的温度骤然攀升，就连两位长老这般的帝境强者都能感受到极强的压迫感。
大长老的瞳孔猛地一缩，魁梧的身躯不由自主地向前倾了几分，粗壮的手指悬在鳞片上方半寸之处。
“没错，这便是赤焰龙王的信物。”
“看来这次的帝路吸引了不少老家伙啊。”
大长老的声音低沉，他们这些妖族中的帝族，对于龙族这曾经的妖族霸主自然不陌生。
在仙古时代，真龙就已经遨游于九天。
那个时候，龙族之中别说真仙，就算是仙王强者，估计也是数不胜数。
而那个时候，龙族就有三十六洞天王之说，代表着龙族的无上强者。
后随着时代变易，乱古时代的那场浩劫之后，仙锁成型，真仙身陨，但龙族的三十六洞天王却一直传承下来，且在每一次黄金大世的末尾，绽放出属于他们的光彩。
而这位赤焰龙王，就在三十六洞天王之中排名第十三，虽不知其具体修为，但能肯定的是，定然是大帝后期的强者。
龙族向来高傲，不屑与其他妖族为伍，乱古大劫之后更是封山避世，极少在三千道域中走动。
如今竟主动遣使送来信物，这背后若说没有大图谋，他打死也不信。

> Chapter 893 Conspiracy (Page 1)
Having achieved his goal, the second elder bowed his hands and left.
"Aren't you afraid that he will report today's secret meeting to the Silver Moon Demon Emperor? We won't be able to get any favors by then."
The first elder sneered, "He doesn't dare to do this. The relationships within the Silver Moon Wolf Clan have always been complicated, and his second elder is not without his reasons."
"Since he came to participate in our secret meeting today, it will never be possible to completely separate the relationship. Even if he wants to fall to the Silver Moon Demon Emperor's side forever, he will always be just an outsider. The other party will have grudges and will not please both sides."
"Besides, do you think the Silver Moon Demon Emperor doesn't know about our dissatisfaction with the royal family?"
"Don't forget, this is the Silver Moon Wolf Clan, and the Silver Moon Demon Emperor's control over this place has already reached its peak."
"The reason why we are not moved is simply because we take into account the background of our two lines and are afraid of bringing a devastating blow to the Imperial Clan."
"Having said that, he is not siding with us after all." The third elder's voice came faintly from the shadow of the hood, hoarse like the friction of dead leaves, "The Demon Emperor is so close to Gu Yun. If the second elder turns to them again, the right to speak between you and me will be greatly reduced. At that time, it will be difficult not only to divide power and balance, but also to protect ourselves."
The great elder was silent for a long time, tapping his thick knuckles lightly on the table, making a dull and regular sound.
After a moment, he raised his eyes, and his gaze fell on the third elder's face hidden under the hood like a knife.
"Since the Third Elder sees things so clearly, does he have some countermeasures?"
The third elder was silent for a moment, then took out a glowing red scale from his arms and placed it gently on the table.
The scales were about half the size of a palm, glowing with a hot dark red light like molten magma, and the surface was densely covered with fine lines.
The moment the scales touched the table, the temperature in the meeting hall suddenly rose, and even the two elders, who were powerful in the Imperial realm, could feel a strong sense of oppression.
The great elder's pupils shrank suddenly, and his burly body leaned forward involuntarily, with his thick fingers hanging half an inch above the scales.
"Yes, this is the token of the Red Flame Dragon King."
"It seems that this time the Imperial Road has attracted a lot of old guys."
The great elder's voice was low. They, the imperial clan among the demon clan, were naturally no strangers to the dragon clan, the former overlord of the demon clan.
In the Ancient Immortal Era, true dragons had already roamed the nine heavens.
At that time, there were probably countless immortals among the Dragon Clan, not to mention true immortals, even powerful immortal kings.
At that time, the Dragon Clan had the theory of the Thirty-Six Cave Heavenly Kings, which represented the supreme power of the Dragon Clan.
Later, as times changed, after the catastrophe in the chaotic ancient times, the Immortal Lock took shape and the true immortal body died. However, the thirty-six cave kings of the Dragon Clan have been passed down, and at the end of each golden age, they bloom with their brilliance.
And this Red Flame Dragon King is ranked thirteenth among the Thirty-Six Cave Heavenly Kings. Although his specific cultivation level is not known, what is certain is that he must be a powerful person in the later period of the Great Emperor.
The dragon clan has always been arrogant and disdained to associate with other demon clans. After the great catastrophe of the ancient times, they even secluded themselves from the world and rarely walked around the Three Thousand Dao Realm.
Now he actually took the initiative to send an envoy to deliver a token. If there was no big conspiracy behind this, he would not believe it even to death.
